title: lissanthe oxycedrus
intro: Lissanthe oxycedrus, commonly known as the prickly heath, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Lissanthe oxycedrus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and reduce the risk of infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
